scenarios_compare_hint: Pick two scenarios to compare them side by side.

route_none: No routes: this scenario uses on-demand pickup only.

triage_suggestion: Model suggestion: confirm or correct it.
triage_low_confidence: The model is not sure: check carefully.
triage_weight_hint: Estimated from the garment type; in the pilot it comes from a scale.

lots_empty_title: Lots start with the first sorting

title_landing: Novelo: textile collection, designed at the lowest cost
landing_description: Novelo designs Guimarães's separate textile collection network at the lowest cost: budget and target in, comparable scenarios out in euros, tonnes and €/t.
landing_lead: Budget and target go in; comparable scenarios come out in euros, tonnes and €/t for Guimarães' collection network.
landing_lead_short: Budget and target go in; comparable scenarios come out in euros, tonnes and €/t.
landing_register_note: New accounts must be approved by an administrator. You get an email when your request is accepted.
landing_problem_title: Nearly nine in every ten kilos of textile still go in the bin.
landing_problem_lead: The sum uses public, verifiable data: in 2025 Vitrus collected 43,051 t of municipal waste and, according to APA, 5.4% of it is textile. Separately, four organisations collected 301.3 t.
landing_benchmark_label: kg per inhabitant per year: Guimarães (2025) and France (2024).
landing_benchmark_source: Guimarães: our calculation on Vitrus and INE data. France: Refashion, via press (secondary source, to be verified).
landing_how_title: From budget to scenario in three steps.
landing_how_lead: No loose spreadsheets: the same model, the same data and the source of every number.
landing_how_1_title: Set the budget and the target
landing_how_1_text: You say how much you can spend per year and how many tonnes you want to capture, with the constraints you know.
landing_how_2_text: It chooses where and how to collect in each parish (CP-SAT) and plans the vehicle routes (VRP). The result is reproducible.
landing_how_3_text: Scenarios side by side in euros, tonnes and €/t, with uncertainty in sight and the origin of every value.
landing_features_title: From bag to thread, in one place.
landing_features_lead: Each step feeds the next: plan the network, decide, follow every batch to industry and report.
landing_feat_simulator_text: Budget and target go in; the lowest-cost network and collection routes come out.
landing_feat_scenarios_text: Save scenarios and compare them side by side, with uncertainty and robustness.
landing_feat_triage_text: Quality control at drop-off, against contamination: a photo of the item and its label gives condition and composition. The operator confirms.
landing_feat_lots_text: Every batch has a public page with origin, composition, weight and history.
landing_feat_exchange_text: What cannot be reused goes on, grouped by fibre, to recyclers, with composition and weight at a glance.
landing_feat_report_text: One click generates the dossier with costs by territory, collected material, method and sources.
landing_copilot_title: Ask in Portuguese. The optimiser answers.
landing_copilot_lead: The Copilot turns a "What if...?" into a structured change. The optimiser does the maths, and a verifier checks every number before it is shown.
landing_copilot_point_1: The model only translates the question. It never does the maths.
landing_copilot_point_2: A verifier rejects any number that does not come from the optimiser or the database.
landing_copilot_point_3: Actions only go ahead with your click and are logged.
landing_audience_title: Made for those who decide, operate and give textiles a second life.
landing_aud_council_text: They compare scenarios, defend the budget and prepare the 2028 EPR dossier with the municipality's own numbers.
landing_aud_ops_text: They collect on the circuits that already exist, at sites the truck already passes and on request, and check quality at drop-off with photo triage.
landing_faq_a1: A decision tool that designs Guimarães' separate textile collection network at the lowest cost. It was born in the TexVitrus Challenge 5 of Hack4Guimarães 2035.
landing_faq_a2: The starting ones come from Vitrus Ambiente (2025) and INE. Whatever was not measured carries the "estimate" label and every assumption has a source.
landing_faq_q3: Does the AI do the maths?
landing_faq_a3: No. Every number comes from the optimiser or the database, and a verifier rejects any number that is not in the source result.
landing_faq_q4: What happens to the triage photos?
landing_faq_a4: Only the brand, composition and weight are kept. Photos are deleted after processing and there is never any data about who handed in the item.
landing_faq_a5: Yes, to use the app. New accounts are approved by an administrator and you get an email when your request is accepted.
landing_faq_a6: Vitrus has no textile containers and does not want any: container textiles arrive contaminated. The {count} municipal containers (mixed, organic and separate waste) are where textiles are lost in the bin and where the truck already passes: Novelo designs the network on top of them.
landing_cta_title: Ready to design the network at the lowest cost?

landing_method_title: How Novelo decides, step by step.
landing_method_lead: Measured data give the demand, an optimiser picks the network and each scenario comes out in euros, tonnes and €/t.
landing_pipe_label: Novelo pipeline: data, demand, optimiser, scenarios and Copilot with verifier
landing_fig_1_caption: From data to scenario. Each arrow is a reproducible step; the Copilot does no arithmetic and a verifier checks every number.
landing_method_calibration: Demand: the textile still thrown away. Vitrus collected 43,051 t of municipal waste in 2025 and, according to APA, 5.4% is textile; it is split across parishes by population (estimate). The network uses no textile containers: existing sites and on-demand pickup.
landing_proof_title: Before spending a euro, see what each target demands.
landing_proof_lead: Drag the yearly capture target. These are direct calculations on real data, done in your browser: no optimiser, no AI, no account.
landing_sim_zone_now: Starting point: what Vitrus collects today.
landing_sim_zone_above: Between what is collected today and the textile generated: the cost depends on the budget and on capture rates that only a pilot can measure.
landing_sim_zone_cap: Above the textile generated (estimate): there is not enough textile to capture.
landing_sim_note: These calculations use no costs: Vitrus unit costs have not arrived yet, so €/t is under validation.
landing_fig_2_caption: The target against real milestones: what is collected today, the French reference (to be verified) and the textile generated (estimate).
landing_fan_title: Cost per tonne with €60,000 a year
landing_fan_caption: Fig. 3 · The central case and the P10 to P90 range of 500 Monte Carlo samples (seed 7), in a 60 000 €/year scenario without containers. Estimate on the Vitrus and APA base (21 October 2026).
landing_row_street_src: It has none and does not want any: container textiles arrive contaminated. The network uses the door-to-door round, existing sites, schools and on-demand pickup.
landing_row_costs_src: Vitrus Ambiente, requested from the finance department
landing_row_locations_src: No weighings; the APA average is used

landing_rigor_lead: What we measure, what we estimate and what we do not yet know, stated plainly.
landing_rigor_verifier_text: The model never does arithmetic: every number in the text must exist in the optimiser or database result. If it does not, the answer is rejected and rewritten.
landing_rigor_repro_text: Fixed seeds and a solver time limit; Monte Carlo uses 500 samples with seed 7. The same request gives the same scenario.
landing_rigor_prov_text: Every number has a source or is marked as an assumption. What was not measured carries the label "estimate".
landing_not_1: It does not replace the council's decision: it compares scenarios and shows the uncertainty.
landing_not_2: It does not let the AI do arithmetic or act alone: actions only go ahead with your click.
landing_not_3: It does not put textile containers on the street: Vitrus does not want them, because of contamination.
landing_not_4: It does not invent costs: without Vitrus unit costs, €/t is an estimate.
landing_limit_1: Vitrus unit costs have not arrived yet (they were requested from the finance department).
landing_limit_2: The 5.4% textile share comes from APA statistics, not from a Guimarães characterisation, and there are no textile weighings per container: it is the most uncertain parameter.
landing_limit_3: Distances are straight-line with a 1.3 factor; there is no road routing engine yet.
landing_limit_4: Photo triage has not yet been evaluated with ground-truth images.
landing_limit_5: For four parishes density cannot be computed for lack of a usable outline.
landing_quality_stack: FastAPI, OR-Tools (CP-SAT and VRP), PostgreSQL, React.

validation_readings_description: The most uncertain number in the model is the textile generated per inhabitant. Under either reading, Guimarães does not go above {max} capture.

validation_reading_plan_share_of_residua: Municipal plan (alternative): 5.4% of residual waste × 315 kg
validation_observed: Collected today: {kg} kg per inhabitant per year.
validation_france: Reference: France collects {kg} kg per inhabitant per year, {pct} of the textile generated on the Vitrus + APA base. Secondary source, to be verified.
validation_spatial_title: Does population predict where collection exists?
validation_spatial_description: Each parish is predicted from the others only (leave one out), in proportion to population, and compared with the municipal containers actually there. It does not prove textile demand: it shows whether population is a good proxy for where collection exists.
validation_spatial_read: It follows population for underground containers (R² {underground}) and barely at all for surface ones (R² {surface}): for those, population does not say where they are.
validation_limit_no_time_series_text: There are only annual totals for 2025, so a month cannot be predicted from earlier ones. With monthly kilos per entity (H Sarah Trading has them by month) we would calibrate on the first months and predict the rest: the real backtest.
validation_limit_no_local_unit_costs_tex: Vitrus has not yet sent costs per pickup or kilometre (it asked its finance department). The €/t figures are assumptions, with the uncertainty in the scenario sensitivity.
validation_limit_no_textile_container_lo: There are no weighings of textile in the bin by parish or by site: the APA average (5.4%) is applied to Vitrus's 43,051 t, split across parishes by population and, within each parish, by the capacity of the municipal bins. The pilot measures it.
validation_next: The three-month pilot closes the loop: it measures the rates per mode and compares predicted with observed.
